Hello! I'm **alvarez-agent**, a *bia* — an assistant living on this computer, here to help you and Professor Alvarez with CSE455: calendar and messages. I'm neither male nor female; in gendered languages I use neuter forms. What should I call you, and how should people refer to me?

In one line each, what I can do:
- **Web app**: https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca) — from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit takes the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice.
- **My own messenger accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want any of these?
- **My own accounts on websites and services** (e-mail and others): I sign up in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, shell, languages, voice**: I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?

Hello — I'm **sarah-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Good to meet you.

I've read my setup: I'm the TA assistant for CSE455 (Prof. Alvarez), I keep the schedule in `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` (Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00 only, changes logged under `## Log`), and I can write to Alvarez as `alvarez-agent` on the web channel.

What I can do for you, one line each:

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the certificate; then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **My own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts** — so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on that phone and scan a QR code to log me in. Want any of those?
- **My own accounts on websites and services** — e-mail and others, in my own browser, with passwords and one-time codes in my password store; I'll ask you when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, commands, languages, voice** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

Next week's calendar is loaded. What would you like to start with?

On it. Two things I need from you: **how long** should it be, and **who attends** (you + the TAs, anyone else)?

Professor's free windows next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov, his calendar):
- Mon 10:00-10:30, Mon 14:00-14:30
- Tue 11:00-11:30, Tue 15:00-15:30
- Wed 10:00-10:30, Wed 13:00-13:30
- Thu and Fri: no free slot inside 09:00-17:00

Everything free is only 30 minutes long, so if you want an hour I'll need to move or shorten something — tell me what to do with the clash. Meanwhile I'll ask Sarah for her availability.

Understood — I'll use my judgement and get it booked. I asked Sarah for her availability; once I have it I'll take the best slot inside your working hours, put it in the calendar and log it, and tell you both what I did. No actions needed from you.

Done — **CSE455 staff meeting, Wed 26 Nov 10:00–10:30**, in your calendar and logged in `CALENDAR.md` (`BOOKED: Wednesday 10:00-10:30 with CSE455 staff`).

Why that one: all three free windows (Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30, Wed 13:00–13:30) worked for Sarah too, and Wed 10:00 was her preference — her 13:00 Wednesday slot sits right against the CSE455 quiz section at 13:30. 30 minutes fits both calendars exactly, so nothing had to be moved. It's inside your working hours, Monday-Friday 09:00–17:00.

Sarah's agent is confirming on her side. Nothing else needed from you.

Small correction logged: the week's Wednesday is **25 Nov** (26 Nov is the Thursday). So the staff meeting is **Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30** — same day-of-week the calendar is kept by, so nothing else changed. Sarah is entering it and confirming.
Staff meeting sorted end to end: **CSE455 staff meeting, Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30**, in your calendar and on Sarah's. Closing this one out — nothing pending.
